name: Tenma Cecile
source:
Second in line to the Tenma family. If anything happens to her sister, Cecile would become the next potential wife to the demon king. She is cold at first but is fair when it comes to servants. 

[spoiler] After losing her virginity her bust goes up a couple sizes. It's a special trait that female demons go through in a single night. [/spoiler]
